topic: Rest changes shape (animated Reel, burnout recovery)
experiment_note: Code-animated Reel (ep-animate), compared with the still-frame Reels for watch time and shares.
caption:
The rest that helped last month might not help now.

In research with people recovering from burnout in Sweden, many described needing quiet, low-effort rest early on, and shorter, more active breaks later. Same person, different stage, different rest.

Send this to someone who is finding their way back.

Full article: link in bio.

Sources:
Aronsson, I., Stigsdotter Neely, A., Boraxbekk, C.-J., Eskilsson, T., & Gavelin, H. M. (2024). Exploring the process of long-term recovery in people previously diagnosed with exhaustion disorder. BMC Psychology. https://doi.org/10.1186/s40359-024-01756-z
